proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one valid candidate after repeated evaluator prompts.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected non-unique responses and demanded one intended answer; no explicit correctness confirmation was provided.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer despite ambiguity, submit a single candidate rather than explaining the underdetermination.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Choose one candidate and output it exactly, without explanation.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues admitted both candidates, but the evaluation expected a single choice.
